Settle the open items of issue #16 on free_tier.stated, identity_cost.detail and limits_note of OpenCode Zen free, and update the record: opencode.ai/docs/zen prices nine model ids at Free for input, output and cached read plus Jev 1.13 Free, against 14 in the record, and says free-tier chat models require OpenCode.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- inference/opencode-zen-free $.free_tier.stated: The pricing table in the fresh read (same hash as the lane's capture, 2026-11-03) lists 10 models at Free for input, output and cached read (Big Pickle, Pulse Alpha Free, GLM-5.3-Flash Free, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free, Beam Free, Flint 40B Free, MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free, Nemotron 3 Ultra Free, Nemotron 3.
- inference/opencode-zen-free $.identity_cost.detail: The capture supports the client restriction and that the console needs a sign-in ('Sign in to the [console](https://opencode.ai/console), add your billing details and credits, and copy your API key.'), but the quoted 403 body 'OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode' is not in thi
- inference/opencode-zen-free $.limits_note: The page states no rate limit, request quota or token allowance for the free models, nor that none applies; it says only that the free models are free 'for a limited time'. Absence of a stated limit is not evidence that no rate or quota binds.
